sermon.title: The Pattern of Moses’ Tabernacle
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: High places were worship done people’s own way. God gave Moses a pattern, a shadow of heavenly things: Jesus the door and sacrifice, the laver of baptism, the Spirit’s seven lamps, prayer as incense, and the ark—us, carrying His law and mercy. Return to His pattern.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then Jesus said to them again, “Most assuredly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep. All who ever came before Me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep did not hear them. I am the door. If anyone enters by Me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.
Therefore purge out the old leaven, that you may be a new lump, since you truly are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, was sacrificed for us.

Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise Him; He has put Him to grief. When You make His soul an offering for sin, He shall see His seed, He shall prolong His days, And the pleasure of the LORD shall prosper in His hand.

faqs.question: How many lamps on the candlestick?
What rested on the ark?
faqs.answer: The glory of God in a cloud by day and fire by night.

faqs.question: What counsel has he heard?
faqs.answer: A voice saying “Michael, you need to change that.”

faqs.question: What do we do when we sin?
faqs.answer: Admit it, receive mercy and keep moving.

faqs.question: What does Aaron’s rod show?
faqs.answer: Life without natural nutrients or water.

faqs.question: Are worldly people our brothers?
faqs.answer: We must reach them, but fight for the kingdom with our brethren.
